summary_1line: Yudhishthira sends Sanjaya to urge peace, asking Dhritarashtra and Duryodhana for reconciliation and even five villages to avoid war.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira solemnly instructs Sanjaya before the gathered Pandavas, asking him to beg Duryodhana for peace and even five small villages.
Sanjaya stands at the gate of Dhritarashtra’s palace announcing he has returned from the Pandavas with a message of great importance.
In the royal chamber, Sanjaya bows before the blind king Dhritarashtra seated on his throne surrounded by counselors.
